title: SDD Entry Contract
description: Artifact handed to the SDD engine by inception-pipeline. Contains topic-key references (not content) and delivery parameters.

change_name.description: Kebab-case change slug derived by requirements-from-transcripts and inherited verbatim by all downstream stages.

project.description: Project identifier used in Engram topic keys.

tier.description: Entry tier: 1=new project (full inception), 2=feature/chore (reuse manifest+architect), 3=small fix (lightweight: requirements + roadmap-insert + estimation only).

requirements_topic_key.description: Engram topic key for the requirements brief written by requirements-from-transcripts.

manifest_refs.description: Engram topic key prefix for manifest artifacts written by project-manifest (e.g. project/{project}/manifest/*).

architect_ref.description: Engram topic key for the final architecture artifact written by project-architect.

roadmap_entry_ref.description: Engram topic key for the roadmap entry written by roadmap-maker.

estimate_topic_key.description: Engram topic key for the pre-start estimate written by sdd-time-estimation.

planned_range_hours.description: Planned implementation effort range in hours from the estimate.

complexity.description: Human-readable complexity assessment (e.g. low, medium, high, very-high).

confidence.description: Confidence level in the estimate (e.g. low, medium, high).

sdd_slice_recommendation.description: Recommended SDD slice strategy for apply phase (e.g. single-batch, two-batch, chained).

delivery_recommendation.description: Recommended delivery strategy (e.g. single-pr, chained-pr, ask-on-risk).

strict_tdd.description: Whether strict TDD mode is active for this change.

artifact_store_mode.description: Artifact persistence backend for this change.
